five_core_diagnostic_answers.q1_acquired_population: The acquired listing observations establish a candidate population of 16,448 distinct normalized lookup keys across 23,584 usable raw data rows (10,276 SEC usable, 5,634 Nasdaq listed, 7,674 Other listed; 23,752 total file rows including 168 SEC rows missing exchange). This population contains 5,789 ETFs, 37 test issues, 484 preferred shares, 468 warrants, 97 units, 58 rights, and 506 ADRs/depositary receipts, leaving approximately 5,871 common operating corporate stock candidates. Directory presence establishes exchange quote eligibility, not verified operating company identity or active trading status. Production population completeness remains NOT_ESTABLISHED.
five_core_diagnostic_answers.q2_market_data_association: Exactly 138 of the 16,448 candidate lookup keys (0.84%) can be associated with existing local market data in ~/.finance_market_store.db. 16,310 candidate keys (99.16%) have zero stored price or candle records. The local market store contains 150 total distinct symbols; the 12 non-feed symbols consist of 2 crypto pairs (BTC-USD, ETH-USD), 8 test fixtures (TST_*, CNT_*, SYM_*), and 2 unlisted/OTC assets (CPRX, DHLGY). Zero database writes occurred.
five_core_diagnostic_answers.q3_scanner_prerequisites: Of the 138 associated records: 136 (98.55%) satisfy the 200-session history floor; 1 satisfies the 50-199 session range (SPCX: 84 bars); and 1 has insufficient history (< 50 bars: GLX with 47 bars). All 138 records have valid positive OHLCV data. However, only 37 records have fresh quotes matching the target session date (2026-10-16), while 100 have stale quotes (primarily 2026-10-12). Semantics indicate data readiness (satisfying inspected local data prerequisites), NOT strategy eligibility or execution readiness. The scanner-ready count (136 historical / 37 fresh) does NOT equal the full-coverage population (16,448).
five_core_diagnostic_answers.q4_data_access_cost_and_capacity: Bounded read measurements in SQLite WAL mode show: existence check = 0.08ms/op; 60-bar load = 0.17ms/op; 252-bar load = 0.50ms/op (2,020 ops/sec). Pure in-memory readiness rule evaluation achieves ~300,000+ ops/sec (0.003 ms/op) when pre-fetched outside SQL loops. Memory footprint is ~14.7 KB per 252-bar symbol (~147 MB for 10,000 symbols). Speculative 8-core projections and PARALLEL_BATCHING are removed. Assessment throughput across the 16,448 candidate population was NOT MEASURED because only 138 symbols (0.84%) have local market data; 16,310 symbols lack stored data. Assessment capacity status remains NOT_ESTABLISHED.
five_core_diagnostic_answers.q5_pipeline_integration_gaps: Adapter -> Validator -> Builder integration is blocked by 5 concrete gaps: (1) Unresolved production identity scheme (security_id omitted to prevent surrogate key synthesis); (2) Missing certified fields in directory feeds (currency, country, primary listing, halts); (3) OpenFIGI decoupling leaves security subtypes and composite FIGIs uncertified; (4) Policy conflict on Rule R02 (common stock only vs PO mandate for foreign US-listed stocks); and (5) Absence of an automated pipeline connecting acquisition runner outputs to UniverseStore.
